setup.advisors: base model + role prompts (Extractor, Reasoner, Verifier), served with vLLM, outputs cached
setup.manager: LoRA on Qwen3.5-9B; S_1 = the paper's one-round SFT manager
setup.extra_rounds: 4-5 for the no-GRPO v3 chain (MedQA, MMLU-Pro, AQuA)
setup.grpo_acceptance: dev acc >= S_k - 1 pt; calls <= S_k + 0.15; call gap >= 0.5 x S_k gap; >= 15% informative revision states (J in (0.02, 0.98)); else G_k := S_k
setup.grpo_guard: every 8 steps on a 64-question probe: call-rate delta <= 0.10 and KL_dec <= 0.05, otherwise roll back to the last good step

arms.dynamic: re-collect with G_{k-1} each round, marginal-value labels, SFT from G_{k-1}, then FA-GRPO
arms.static: reuse S_1's labels every round, SFT from G_{k-1}, then FA-GRPO
arms.success: like dynamic but any trajectory ending in a correct answer is a demonstration (shortest path not required)

versions.v1: paper SFT target (draft letter supervised) + GRPO
versions.v3: draft letter never supervised (route-only loss), no GRPO
